title: GIG-3316: Strip NO_AUTO_CREATE_USER On MySQL Postmaclone Restore
description: Strips the removed MySQL 5.7 sql_mode NO_AUTO_CREATE_USER from dumps before restore so Hydra produce can load into MySQL 8 scratch.

test_plan.description: Sanitizer strips NO_AUTO_CREATE_USER from sql_mode only
steps: Confirm lone, leading, trailing, and middle list cases keep NO_AUTO_VALUE_ON_ZERO
Confirm INSERT text mentioning the token is unchanged
Confirm the stream filter rewrites across 8-byte bucket boundaries
